patches_added.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches_added.description: Lets you hide the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over a pin you open, each with its own switch, so they stop covering the picture. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: HushPinterest settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Pinterest logo at the top of your home feed or Pinterest's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Pinterest icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Echo Pro, including the 15- and 31-band equalizers, compressor, limiter and Safe Hearing protect mode.

patches_added.name: GmsCore support
patches_added.description: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks downloading every surah, lyrics and tafsir, Android Auto, background playback controls, and insights.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Stops crash and error reports from reaching Sentry.

patches_modified.name: Disable usage tracking
patches_modified.description: Stops app usage events from being uploaded. Local usage tracking remains enabled.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the energy schedule, habit tools, smart alarm and progress insights. Requires a RISE account.

patches_modified.name: Disable tracking
patches_modified.description: Disables analytics and crash reporting.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches_modified.name: Unlock pro
patches_modified.description: Unlocks task lists, callouts, app lock, and the notebook, tag, colour and reminder limits. Requires a signed-in account. The server still enforces storage, attachment size, monographs and SMS 2FA.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and Also from Meta in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, so you can open these settings from inside Messenger. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Stop MQTT logging
patches_modified.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger's MQTT client sends. Messenger 582 sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messages, calls and active status share that connection and keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed or Facebook's app icon. Its App name option shows a name you pick under the icon. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed or Facebook's app icon. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.

patches_modified.name: Keep the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap, and another switch lets a tap anywhere on the bar jump there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch lets it slide away as you scroll, and two more keep the tab bar or the top bar on screen instead. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.
patches_modified.previous_description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch lets it slide away as you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches_modified.description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats. Also carries Leave calls and chats to Messenger, a separate switch that starts off and leaves ringing and chat notifications to Messenger while it's installed and enabled.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats.

patches_added.description: Adds MAIN and DEFAULT intent-filters to MusicActivity so external controllers like Google Maps can open the app.

patches_modified.name: Allow external media browser connections
patches_modified.description: Allows Google Maps, Android Auto, and third-party media controllers to connect to YouTube Music.

patches_added.name: Bypass GeoBlock Region Restriction
patches_added.description: Forces CapCut GeoBlock config lists (cert, dock, entrance, page, scheme) to empty so region-blocked surfaces stay enabled. Server-refused content may still fail to load.

patches_added.name: Custom Deep Links
patches_added.description: Registers intent filters to open custom links directly in the app

patches_added.name: Custom Fonts
patches_added.description: Applies custom typography to post and profile text

patches_added.name: Round Off Numbers
patches_added.description: Enable or disable rounding off numbers

patches_added.name: X Background Slimmer
patches_added.description: Disables background WorkManager services, home screen widgets, and Cast/NFC companion services to reduce background resource consumption.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement, Firebase Performance, Braze marketing SDK, and strips advertising identifiers.
patches_modified.previous_description: Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement and Firebase Performance Trace dispatchers, and strips advertising identifiers.

patches_modified.name: Navigation UI
patches_modified.description: Bottom navigation, FAB, tabs and bars

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the Save button and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Find the reel you came from
patches_modified.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. patches_added.name: Default video quality
patches_added.description: Starts every video at one resolution instead of the app's per-video choice; a resolution the video lacks falls back to its highest available (8K included when the stream spoof provides it). Changeable in the headset's Patch settings; Auto keeps the app's own behaviour.

patches_added.name: QUIC (HTTP/3)
patches_added.description: Adds the in-headset switch for QUIC, the transport under HTTP/3: TLS over UDP, used for this app's API and media requests. Leave it on unless playback stalls on a network that blocks or throttles UDP 443 (corporate Wi-Fi, many VPNs), where turning it off forces TCP/TLS. A change applies after the app restarts.

patches_removed.name: Spoof osName (Android Automotive)
patches_removed.description: Reports the app as an Android Automotive device, the way the phone patch set blocks video ads.

patches_removed.name: Disable DRC audio
patches_removed.description: Disables DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio.

patches_removed.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches_removed.description: Adds an option (off by default) to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol; selecting the patch alone changes nothing until the option is enabled.

patches_removed.name: Hide stitched ads (SSAI)
patches_removed.description: Removes the client side ad configuration and cue points for server-stitched (SSAI) streams. It does not remove the ad itself; keeping ads out is the Extension patch's streaming spoof. Off by default.

patches_added.name: Add your own media apps as Waze audio partners
patches_added.description: Waze's audio-partner list is a table compiled into the app - it contains Spotify and an internal demo, and Waze never scans installed apps (getInstalledPackages has zero references in the APK). One patch for the whole media feature: it adds your own entries to that table at the point where Waze persists each partner's scope, and declares the media browser service in Waze's manifest, without which Android hides your players from Waze entirely. Waze's own availability check is opened as well: any installed app qualifies as a partner, and Waze reaches it through the generic media-browser client instead of requiring Waze's own SDK.

patches_added.name: Map theme
patches_added.description: Recolours Waze's own map skin (Google Maps-like light/dark, or OLED black) by rewriting the compiled skin descriptions in the APK, and raises the app's versionCode so Waze re-extracts its skins instead of serving the cached stock ones. Applied at patch time: change the theme by re-patching. No injected code, nothing to render at runtime.

patches_added.name: OLED dark mode
patches_added.description: Makes the night map truly dark for OLED screens: the map background becomes pure black (#000000) and the road colours are lifted slightly (one Waze lighten step) so they stay readable against it. Only the background and the road palette change - day mode, labels, traffic and routes are left as Waze ships them. Applied at patch time: no runtime switch and nothing injected into the app. Steps aside if Map theme is also selected.

patches_added.name: Unlock driver moods
patches_added.description: Waze's mood picker is gated three ways: an eligibility check that accepts only one mood name (and reads the beta-moods flag), a baby-account gate that hides moods, and a filtered native catalogue call. This opens all three, so moods already in the local catalogue - including special and hidden entries - become selectable. Artwork Waze has never downloaded is not invented.

patches_added.name: AMOLED dark mode
patches_added.description: Replaces Waze's stock night map with an AMOLED one: the map canvas becomes true black (#000000) and the nine road families are lifted 15% toward white so they keep their contrast against it. Only the night skins change - day mode, labels, traffic and route colours stay as Waze ships them. Applied at patch time: no runtime switch, nothing injected.

patches_added.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches_added.description: Stops the Play Store from offering or applying updates to Waze: the manifest version code is locked above Play's maximum (2,100,000,000 + minutes), so the store always sees the installed copy as newer than its listing. The value advances on every re-patch, so Waze still refreshes its extracted resources, and Waze's own package-version accessor keeps reporting the pre-lock code. Ported from Morphe's universal "Disable Play Store updates" (GPLv3).

patches_added.name: Morphe YouTube Music as a Waze audio partner
patches_added.description: Makes Morphe YouTube Music (app.morphe.android.apps.youtube.music) usable as Waze's audio partner: the package is declared in Waze's manifest so Android's package visibility lets Waze see it, and it is added to the audio-partner table (SdkConfiguration.appConfigs) whenever Waze rebuilds that roster. Ported from Loupric/morphe-waze-music-patch (GPLv3).
